steps.title: git push
steps.detail: Webhook from GitHub triggers the orchestrator with the commit SHA and target environment.

steps.title: CI runner
steps.detail: A short-lived GitHub Actions job runs unit tests and produces a locked manifest.

steps.title: Build VM
steps.detail: The orchestrator claims a warm Firecracker VM, restores its snapshot, and runs the user's build command.

steps.title: Artifact store
steps.detail: Build output is chunked and uploaded to Cloudflare R2 with a content-hash prefix for perfect caching.

steps.title: Edge router
steps.detail: A DNS-level router flips the target hostname to the new artifact bundle atomically.
